'''Roe Jung-hye''' ({{Korean|hangul=노정혜|hanja=盧貞惠}};<ref>{{Cite web |last=조선일보 |date=2020-08-13 |title=[사람들] 로레알 여성생명과학상 노정혜 교수 |url=https://www.chosun.com/site/data/html_dir/2002/06/14/2002061470281.html |access-date=2025-08-01 |website=조선일보 |language=ko}}</ref> born 1 March 1957) is a South Korean professor of [[Molecular biology]] at [[Seoul National University]]<ref name=":0">{{Cite web|last=|first=|title=노정혜 - Professor - 분자미생물학 연구실|trans-title=Jung-hye Roe - Professor - Molecular Microbiology Lab|url=https://biosci.snu.ac.kr/jhroe/professor|access-date=2020-08-02|website=BIOLOGICAL SCIENCES, SNU|language=ko-KR}}</ref> served as the 6th President of [[National Research Foundation of Korea]] - the first woman to lead the Foundation or its preceding foundations<ref>{{Cite web|date=2018-07-09|title=한국연구재단 이사장에 노정혜 교수|trans-title=Professor Roe Jung-hye as Chairman of the National Research Foundation of Korea|url=http://www.hani.co.kr/arti/society/internalmove/852581.html|access-date=2020-08-02|website=[[The Hankyoreh]]|language=ko}}</ref> from 2018 to 2021.

From 1986 Roe has been teaching at her alma mater receiving full tenure in 1997. She undertook several roles in her university such as the Vice Dean of its College of Natural Sciences and Dean of Office of Research Affairs - the first woman to run the Office.<ref>{{Cite web|date=2019-10-25|title=노정혜 연구재단 이사장 "여성공학자 비율 낮아…편견 탓"|trans-title=Roe Jung-hye, Chairman of the Research Foundation, "The ratio of female engineers is low…because of prejudice"|url=https://www.hankyung.com/society/article/201910251386Y|access-date=2020-08-02|website=[[The Korea Economic Daily]]|language=ko}}</ref> She is also leading its School of Biological Sciences and BK21 programme for Biological Sciences from 2009.<ref name=":0" /> Roe has been active in academia as well serving as a member of editorial board of [[Microbiology (journal)|Microbiology]] from 2007 to 2011, [[Journal of Bacteriology]] from 2012 to 2015 and [[Annual Review of Microbiology]] from 2012 to 2017.<ref name=":1">{{Cite web|last=|first=|title=Roe, Jung-Hye - Current Faculty - Faculty Members|url=https://biosci.snu.ac.kr/en/people/faculty?mode=view&profidx=13|access-date=2020-08-02|website=BIOLOGICAL SCIENCES, SNU|language=en}}</ref>

In addition to academia, Roe has been active in policy making and advisory instruments of the government. Roe was a board member of now-National Research Council of Science & Technology from 2005 to 2008 and a member of Presidential Advisory Council on Science and Technology from 2008 to 2013 to which she has served as an advisor from 2013.<ref name=":0" />

In 2021 Roe's presidency of the [[National Research Foundation of Korea]] came to an end making her the first person to complete the Foundation's fixed term of three years.<ref>{{Cite web |last=오 |first=수진 |date=2021-08-26 |title=3년임기 첫채운 연구재단 이사장 "재단 독립성·자율성강화해야" |url=https://www.yna.co.kr/view/AKR20210826086500017 |access-date=2022-05-13 |website=[[Yonhap News Agency]] |language=ko}}</ref>

Roe is a member of [[Korean Academy of Science and Technology]] and a fellow of [[American Academy of Microbiology]].<ref name=":0" />

Roe holds two degrees - a bachelor in [[Microbiology]] from [[Seoul National University]] and a doctorate in [[Molecular biology]] from [[University of Wisconsin–Madison]].<ref name=":1" />

== Awards ==
* 2002: [[L’Oréal Korea-UNESCO for Women in Science Award]], [[UNESCO]] Korea and [[L'Oréal]] Korea<ref>{{Cite web|title=로레알 여성 생명과학상 수상자 선정|trans-title=L'Oreal Women's Life Science Award Winner|url=https://news.naver.com/main/read.nhn?mode=LSD&mid=sec&oid=001&aid=0000187652&sid1=001|access-date=2020-08-02|website=[[Naver News]]|language=ko}}</ref>
* 2006: [[Woman Scientist/Engineer of the Year Award]], [[Ministry of Science and ICT]]<ref>{{Cite web|title=여성과학기술자상 수상한 노정혜교수와 가족들|trans-title=Professor Roe Jung-hye and her family received the Female Scientist and Engineer Award|url=https://news.naver.com/main/read.nhn?mode=LSD&mid=sec&oid=003&aid=0000269112&sid1=001|access-date=2020-08-02|website=[[Naver News]]|language=ko}}</ref>
* 2011: [[Korea Science Award]]<ref>{{Cite news|title=박종일ㆍ최기운ㆍ노정혜 교수, 한국과학상 수상|trans-title=Professor Park Jong-il, Choi Ki-woon, and Roe Jung-hye received the Korea Science Award|url=https://www.nocutnews.co.kr/news/899681}}</ref>
